title: Files built several ways
summary: A source the database lists under several commands offers each one as a context
prose: When a build compiles one file more than once, for example once per configuration, every command is a context the editor can switch between, labeled by its flags.

value.wrong: each label lists every -D, -O, -std and -g flag of its command, the shared -std=c++20 included, rather than only the flags that set the commands apart
